target: SST anomaly at a withheld pixel
timing_contract: Retrospective reconstruction of one daily map, using twelve fixed neighboring pixels from the same date. Not a future forecast.
calibration: Cardinal neighbors at4 and8 pixels plus four diagonal neighbors at4pixels. Target centers lie on a40pixel lattice and can never be calibration pixels for any scored center.
independent_unit: Complete20degree geographic tile for scoring; all tiles belong to one dependent global map, not independent temporal replicates.
scope_limits: Fixed complete-water neighborhoods exclude coasts, ice and missing neighborhoods.
No climate evolution, causal ocean mechanism or coral bleaching hazard is identified. This is not the NOAA coral bleaching heat-stress product.
exposure: Only dimensions, flags, coordinates and scale metadata were inspected before this fixed geometry/hash split. All resulting scores become exposed.
uncertainty_policy: Tile-balanced errors and individual tile results only; no population confidence from dependent pixels.
outcome_exposure: All packaged outcomes exposed after this campaign.
